errors.text_span: Dargestellt sind zwei durchgezogene Linien (blau und violett) auf der linken Achse sowie zwei Reihen von Dreiecksmarkern (blaue und rote, ohne sichtbare Verbindungslinie) auf der rechten Achse.
errors.evidence: The description claims the two solid lines (blue and purple) are on the left axis and the two series of triangle markers (blue and red) are on the right axis. This is incorrect. Both the solid lines and the markers are plotted against the left y-axis ("IWF Fiskalindex"). Their values (e.g., lines peaking around 1.0-2.0, markers having values like 1.7, 1.3) are consistent with the left axis scale (0 to 2.5) and inconsistent with the right axis scale (60 to 120).

errors.text_span: Die blauen Dreiecke (rechte Achse) liegen in den späten 1990er‑Jahren um etwa 75, um 2005–2008 um etwa 85, um 2010–2012 um etwa 95 und ab etwa 2013 bis 2020 um ungefähr 110.
errors.evidence: The description assigns values to the blue triangles based on the right y-axis, which is incorrect as they are plotted against the left axis. For example, it states the value is ~110 from 2013-2020, but the markers are clearly plotted at a value of 2.1 on the left axis. All reported numerical values for this series are wrong because the wrong axis was used for reference.

errors.text_span: Die roten Dreiecke (rechte Achse) beginnen Mitte/Ende der 1990er nahe 60, liegen um 2005 in der Nähe von 75–80, erreichen um 2010 etwa 90, liegen um 2013–2017 um etwa 100 und sind gegen 2019/2020 leicht darunter (knapp unter bzw. um 100) eingezeichnet.
errors.evidence: The description assigns values to the red triangles based on the right y-axis, but they are plotted against the left y-axis. For instance, it claims a value of ~100 for 2013-2017, but the markers are at ~1.7 on the left axis scale. All reported values are incorrect due to misinterpreting the axis mapping.
The description states the blue line in the left chart starts 'just below or around 0'. The line clearly starts slightly above 0, at approximately 0.05.

The description omits that the two line plots in the figure represent 'Gesamtstaat' (general government) on the left and 'Zentralstaat' (central government) on the right, which is a key distinguishing feature shown in the y-axis labels.
The description fails to complete the description for the right-hand plot. It cuts off after describing the axes.
